items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: had Joey Bushkin, who was his piano player, accompanist

ctx.x: Was he in good voice at the concert?

Excellent. The thing happened up there that was really out of sight, as the jargon of the word game goes today. He came on to do his first number and after he did his first number, the complete sound system went out. He was appearing before a sell-out crowd in this new Concord Jazz Festival Arena, which had about 7,000 people in it, and he was so cool and professional. When it went out, he never left the stage.
